text:
maya: Quick sync — carving Q3 roadmap slices for hosted inference. Need a short triage: chat latency improvements vs embeddings cost optimization vs rerank accuracy. Which gets the most engineering weight this quarter?
ryan: TL;DR we can only land two big efforts given infra headcount. My vote is latency + embeddings cost. Chat improvements are higher risk for the runtime. :thinking_face:
lina: Agree with ryan. Customer asks: 3 enterprise accounts asked for embeddings unit cost reduction, 2 wanted streaming/chat latency. Rerank is more niche but high impact for search customers.
jax: From ML side, rerank improvements need eval harness and new datasets — that's 4-6 weeks of work before infra touches it. Embeddings quantization + cache improvements are lower-risk and give immediate $/unit wins.
maya: Proposed priority order: 1) embeddings cost (quantize + cache hints), 2) chat latency (fast path & batching), 3) rerank accuracy (pilot). Any blockers?
oliver: Ops note — if we push embedding quantization we need to update the model catalog metadata and add a compatibility flag for Dedicated customers. That's a minor console change but requires migration plan.
ryan: Perf details: for chat latency we can implement an opportunistic short-seq kernel that helps p50 for <256 tokens. Impact estimate: p50 -15% p95 -5%. Effort: 3 sprint dev + 1 sprint infra tuning.
lina: Launch criteria suggestions: - embeddings: 30% token-cost reduction in our internal workload + no >1% quality regressions on curated prompts. - chat: p50 latency improvement and no increase in error rate. - rerank: measurable lift on NDCG@10 in pilot customers.
jax: Adding eval checklist (quick paste):
```
- Baseline eval on last 2 months of prompts
- Regression tests: top-100 anchors
- Human spot-check (20 cases)
- Latency/cost A/B run (1 week)
```
maya: Can we map owners + rough timeline? Lina to own customer communications, Ryan to lead chat perf, Jax to lead rerank eval and embeddings model-side changes, Eng infra (oliver) for deployment and Dedicated compatibility.
oliver: Noted. For Dedicated compatibility we need a migration window and a toggle off by default. Ops can run a 2-week gradual rollout.
ryan: One more tradeoff: embeddings caching gives the biggest bang if we add prefix reuse heuristics. That does increase memory pressure on servers — need config knobs per tenant.
lina: For prioritization, suggest gating rerank pilot until embeddings is shipped and we have updated cost metrics. That lets us free up cycles.
maya: Decision (quick): Q3 plan = (A) Embeddings cost & cache (primary), (B) Chat latency improvements (secondary), (C) Rerank pilot (deferred start month 2). I'll update roadmap doc and OKRs based on this.
jax: I'll start the eval harness now and post PR for datasets by EOD.
ryan: I'll sketch the kernel change + perf ticket and tag infra.
oliver: I'll draft Dedicated migration runbook and a toggle API.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: perf-proto branch -> staging on 1768882000 by ryan. :rocket:
maya: Great. Follow-ups: Lina to draft customer note template, Jax/Ryan sync on A/B test design, Oliver to estimate memory/config knobs. Ping me when tickets are up. :thumbsup:
